title: BigP3BCI Study N — 9x8 dry/wet electrode comparison (8 ALS subjects)
description: This derivative dataset presents a processed subset of the BigP3BCI study, focusing on Study N which compares 9x8 dry and wet electrode configurations in 8 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients. The dataset contains EEG recordings from a P300-based brain-computer interface speller paradigm, with 2 sessions per subject and standardized event annotations using HED 8.4.0. Data were acquired at 256 Hz using a g.USBamp amplifier with 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage. Subjects performed a P300 speller task with visual stimulus presentation on 9x8 character grids. The paradigm included target and non-target stimulus classes with a trial interval of 0-1.0 seconds. Data were processed using MOABB (Mother of All BCI Benchmarks) version 1.5.0 with P300 ERP feature extraction and calibration-then-test cross-validation methodology.
